programme.desc: Ny skoldag och klassens lärare bestämmer att dagens utmaning för eleverna är att förbereda roliga timmen för varandra.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Parceremonidag och spänt läge från start när flera tjejer hänger löst. Deras öde hamnar i deras partners händer då de ska skriva prov i sexualkunskap där veckans sista immunitet delas ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Skoltidens fasor är förbi och nu är den nyutexaminerade Paradiseklassen redo för yrkeslivet. Kontorsveckan börjar dock dystert. Firman går dåligt och någon måste bort.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Finalveckan är igång och som sig bör finns nu ingen lugn stund att vänta för gästerna på hotellet. Det har blivit dags att bekänna färg och visa om vänskap eller spel går först.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Ett tufft beslut väntar för hotellets manliga gäster och medan gästlistan kortas ner smyger sig den sista parceremonin allt närmare – och snart står det klart vilka två par som blir klara för final.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Innan finalparet koras har det blivit dags att stå till svars för sina synder i en sista grillning. Ett par kommer stå som segrare och göra upp om prissumman på en halv miljon kronor i kulceremonin!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: De återstående paren vaknar med pirr i kroppen. Finalen är snart här! Men först väntar säsongens sista parceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Vid frukosten får deltagarna ett brev där det står att det under dagen kommer bli ”Paradise Hotel Awards” där de ska förbereda en gala med prisutdelning för gamla deltagare som kommer tillbaka.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Efter en dramatisk och lång säsong är det till slut dags att kora vinnarna av Paradise Hotel 2015.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 8
programme.desc: Det spekuleras för fullt på hotellet om vem tjuven är. Veckans vinnare från Paradise Motel får i uppdrag att återvända till Paradise Hotel som polis och lösa mysteriet. Det har även blivit dags för säsongens första grillparty: Pandoras ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 8
programme.desc: Skolveckan fortsätter och nu är det killarnas tur att gnugga geniknölarna inför ett klurigt prov. Det blir även roliga timmen i klass PH – där eleverna får visa vem som är klassens främsta clown.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 8
programme.desc: FINALVECKAN ÄR HÄR! Smail, Emma, Kristian, Anna, Fanny och Hermansson är de som överlevde den skoningslösa Helvetesveckan och som nu är ensamma kvar på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Vem ska sova med vem och hur låter egentligen en hare? Många frågor cirkulerar på hotellet och äntligen får gästerna möjlighet att ställa varandra mot väggen i säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Svek och lögner som avslöjats är uppladdningen inför kvällens Pandoras Ask, som slutar i kaos. Dessutom har datorn blivit hackad! Vilka filer har blivit raderade och måste checka ut från hotellet?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Domaren fortsätter dela ut guldtröjor och det har blivit dags för finalmatch med immunitet i potten. Pandoras Ask blir en hetsig historia, och vilka har egentligen skrivit de sista frågorna?

programme.title: Spargrisarna Kan rädda världen
programme.desc: Det här ska väl bli roligt. En ny revy. En väldigt ny revy till och med. Med fyra farbröder. Det har ju verkligen alla förutsättningar att bli hur roligt som helst.

programme.desc: Mest sedda klippen från Youtube av Galenskaparna materialet

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 6

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 4
programme.desc: I ett lopp tvärs genom Japan försöker Jeremy Clarkson bevisa att en Nissan GT-R är snabbare än landets ultraeffektiva kollektivtrafiksystem.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 3

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 402

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie Fest
programme.desc: Hela huset firar Abbies 21-årsdag med en fest som huset sällan skådat - och självklart bjuder de Abbies momor! Familjen delar en gråtmild stund när deras tid tillsammans kommer till ett slut.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: All Change In The House
programme.desc: Geordisarna är tillbaka! Men denna gång slänger Anna och Scotty T in fyra nykomlingar. De gör sitt bästa för att passa in men gamlingarna finns alltid tillgängliga för att visa dem hur man festar!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Nathan Needs A House Party

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Beau & Bethan Get It On!
programme.desc: Nathan och Chloe mår inte bra och tjejerna har förfest utan att bjuda in honom. Trots att han inte är ute efter nåt förhållande dras Beau till Bethan och de får ihop det.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.desc: Pojkarna skickas till Costa Ricas regnskog som en del av kören Getting Gay With Kids turné.

programme.title: South Park: Glödhet katolsk kärlek
programme.desc: Fader Maxi reser till Rom när en skandal inom den katolska kyrkan får kyrkorna i South Park att stå halvtomma.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemin
programme.desc: South Park börjar likna Cloverfield när Randy visar dem skakiga inspelningar han gjort med sin videokamera av en stor mystisk varelse som härjar jorden runt.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemin II: Marsvinigt
programme.desc: Enorma marsvin anfaller städer runt om i världen. Pojkarna har nyckeln som kan rädda mänskligheten, men de sitter fast i Anderna.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Nail Salon / Fun
programme.desc: En plan för att hindra att nagellack spricker går fel, och Nathan tar itu med sin värsta personlighetsbrist.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Hero
programme.desc: Nathan försöker bevisa att det bor en hjälte inom oss alla.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Nathan For You: A Celebration
programme.desc: I ett specialavsnitt som leds av Anthony Napoli, pratar Nathan med tidigare gäster som Brian Wolfe och Spökmäklaren.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Richards Tip
programme.desc: Nathan hjälper en småstadskrog genom en extremt generös handling.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Andy vs. Uber
programme.desc: Nathan slår sig ihop med en kämpande taxichaufför för att slå ut Uber.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Chili Shop / Massage Parlor
programme.desc: Nathan hjälper en butik som säljer chili att sälja sin mat till hockeyfans, och en massagesalong lär sig hur man får kunder att handla mer.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Shipping Logistics Company
programme.desc: Nathan lär en internationell exportör hur man skickar brandvarnare tullfritt.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Computer Repair / Psychic
programme.desc: Nathan hjälper en datorreparatör att få allmänhetens tillit, och ett mediums marknadsföring blir personlig.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Anecdote
programme.desc: Nathan finslipar sin berättarteknik.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Finding Frances Part 1
programme.desc: I detta tvåtimmarsprogram försöker Nathan att återförena en Bill Gates-imitatör med hans förlorade kärlek.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes Terror By Night
programme.desc: Holmes is hired by Roland Carstairs to prevent the theft of the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond owned by Carstairs' mother, Lady Margaret. Believing the diamond will be stolen on a train trip from London to Edinburgh.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes in Washington
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson travel to Washington D.C. in order to prevent a secret document from falling into enemy hands.

programme.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate the legend of a supernatural hound, a beast that may be stalking a young heir on the fog-shrouded moorland that makes up his estate.

programme.title: The Pearl of Death
programme.desc: When a valuable pearl with a sinister reputation is stolen, Sherlock Holmes must investigate its link to a series of brutal murders.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 7
programme.desc: Haidar har helt släppt Andrea efter Chris avslöjande och siktar nu in sig på den nya jokern i stället. Dessutom får deltagarna ett brev som vänder upp och ner på allt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 7
programme.desc: Kärleksveckan fortsätter – och det är dags för en casanova att checka in. Alla är riktigt nervösa inför den nya jokerns entré. Samtidigt är det flera krossade hjärtan bland killarna på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 7
programme.desc: Ikväll ska en kille tvingas lämna – och det är orolig stämning på hotellet. Nya jokern har fått stor makt, och ska välja en tjej som blir låst med honom vid kvällens parceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 8
programme.desc: Äntligen KÄRLEKSVECKA på Paradise Hotel! Det har blivit dags för "Afrodite" att checka in – och hon visar sig vara ett välbekant ansikte för Mos…

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 8
programme.desc: Kärleksveckan fortsätter, och nu är det dags för den första vinnaren från Paradise Motel att äntra det "riktiga" hotellet. Gänget välkomnar PH-veteranen Smail tillbaka som hotellets kärleksgud Amor.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 8
programme.desc: Kärleksveckan lider mot sitt slut. Hos vilket par spirar romantiken lite extra, och vem får sitt hjärta krossat? Det är rejält spänd stämning på hotellet inför kvällens parceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Skoltidens fasor är förbi och nu är den nyutexaminerade Paradiseklassen redo för yrkeslivet. Kontorsveckan börjar dock dystert. Firman går dåligt och någon måste bort.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: Det är dags för skolstart och en välbekant rektor kliver in genom portarna till paradiset. De lata dagarna är över och deltagarna måste direkt börja plugga till ett tufft prov.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: Det är rejält stelt i paradiset när det uppdagas att Hampus tillbringat natten med Claudia. Rektorn har rättat deltagarnas prov och de som fått sämst resultat ska splittras.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: På skolschemat för dagen står det Roliga timmen och rektorn är redo med skämskudden. Efteråt blir det klassfest.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: Det är dags för det stora provet där ett av paren kommer bli immuna i veckans parceremoni. En deltagare tvingas lämna paradiset och de andra får sommarlov.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 7
programme.desc: Sommarlovet är över och nu ringer det in till skolvecka! Hotellgästerna får klä på sig skoluniformer och de får veta att det har blivit dags för klassens elevrådsordförande att checka in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 7
programme.desc: Skoldagen är i full gång och det är dags för terminens första prov. Utanför lektionssalen har Chris bestämt sig för att berätta för Andrea om sina känslor – ett samtal som slutar med hjärtekross.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Efter en dramatisk och lång säsong är det till slut dags att kora vinnarna av Paradise Hotel 2015.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: I en rosceremoni gör en av deltagarna ett högst oväntat val. Och i den allra sista parceremonin tvingas ytterligare en deltagare bort från hotellet och det står nu klart vilka som står i final.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: Finaldags i paradiset. Vilket par kommer vinna Paradise Hotel? Kan vinnarna verkligen lita på varandra eller kommer någon av dem att kasta kulan?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 7
programme.desc: FINALVECKAN ÄR HÄR – ngelica, Jake, Sanel, Haidar, Lisa, Vanessa och John är de som har klarat sig nästan hela vägen fram till mållinjen. Men redan i kvällens avsnitt ska sju deltagare bli fyra.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 7
programme.desc: Det har blivit dags för FINAL och de fyra som kämpat sig kvar till slutet inleder dagen med frukost på sängen. Sedan är det dags för finalceremoni, där de utslagna deltagarna ska lägga sin röst på vilket par de vill ska vinna!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 8
programme.desc: FINALVECKAN ÄR HÄR! Smail, Emma, Kristian, Anna, Fanny och Hermansson är de som överlevde den skoningslösa Helvetesveckan och som nu är ensamma kvar på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Domaren fortsätter dela ut guldtröjor och det har blivit dags för finalmatch med immunitet i potten. Pandoras Ask blir en hetsig historia, och vilka har egentligen skrivit de sista frågorna?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Det är upp till bevis på Pandoras Ask, kommer den planerade lögnen att avslöjas? Två medium ska utses för att väcka ett av spökena till liv, men vilka som ska få chansen är inte helt självklart.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Vem är snyggast? Vem spelar dubbelt? Och vem är sugen på vem? Gästerna ställs mot väggen i säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: En vildhingst checkar in på hotellet, men vem av tjejerna i stallet kommer lyckas tämja honom? Pennorna vässas inför Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Under Pandoras Ask blir det snabbt tydligt att det skaver rejält mellan deltagarna. Vänskap ifrågasätts och bakom fasaderna bubblar känslor som inte längre går att hålla tillbaka.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Ytterligare en kejsarinna anländer till hotellet och hemligheter läcker ut, som sticker i vissa gästers ögon. I Pandoras Ask reder gästerna ut oklarheter och på festen bryter ett hetsigt bråk ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: En PH-Legend checkar in i kampen mot superskurkens planer – men vem spelar på vilken sida egentligen? Säsongens första pandoras ask väntar och skurkaktiga planer hotar att förstöra stämningen totalt!

programme.title: Där fick du
programme.desc: En fars av Krister Classon om bröderna Sten och Jonas Bengtsson och deras mindre smarta grannen Ivar Rask…

programme.title: Stulen Kärlek - Vallarna succé
programme.desc: Unik återförening av välkända humorduon Stefan & Krister när sommarens skrattfest ”Stulen Kärlek” hade premiär på Vallarna i Falkenberg.

programme.title: Rolandz Dansar igen
programme.desc: Det har blivit dags för Rolandz att följa upp det hyllade albumet ”Jajamen” med en turné i norra Sverige. Men att vara på turné är inte alltid lätt, speciellt om man heter Roland Järverup och saknar sin mamma,

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 5
programme.desc: Invignings-Grand Prix för Top Gear Motorhome är en jättesuccé och den nya Honda Civic Type-R testas för att se om den är lika bra som originalet.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 3
programme.desc: Teamet försöker hitta ett nytt fordon som kan ersätta den oansenliga ambulansen, innan de tar i tu med a rad utmaningar.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 5
programme.desc: Jeremy och Richard försöker designa en bil som riktar sig till äldre människor, medan James testkör den nya Range Rover.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 3
programme.desc: I ett lopp från Wembley till San Siro i Milano kör Jeremy en Shelby Mustang GT500, medan Richard och James tar till det paneuropeiska järnvägsnätet.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 3
programme.desc: Teamet gör en biltur på motorvägarna genom USA, och utför olika utmaningar i bilar som köpts för mindre än 1 000 dollar.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Travis Tritt
programme.desc: Country music legend, Travis Tritt is living in fear of the inexplicable paranormal experiences he is having at his lakeside cabin nestled in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Georgia.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Harry Lennix
programme.desc: Actor Harry Lennix (The Blacklist, Dollhouse, The Matrix Reloaded) returns to the notoriously haunted hotel in Eureka Springs, Arkansas.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus från helvetet Promo
programme.desc: Kom in, om du vågar! Under dagen besöker vi spökjägare och extrema samlare, medan vi på kvällen skruvar upp kusligheterna med skräckfilm och kliver in de mest skrämmande spökhusen.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Alysia Reiner
programme.desc: Orange Is The New Black's Alysia Reiner begs for Psychic Medium Kim Russo's help in confronting spirits in her Harlem Brownstone that are terrorizing her young daughter.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Harlan County Courthouse was both sanctuary and execution site. The town hub that witnessed a brutal revenge killing and countless trials of corrupt lawmen is the site of the country's most haunted building.

programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.desc: För att lindra sina ekonomiska problem söker en anställd på en resebyrå efter ett fruset lik, som råkar vara eftertraktat av två mördare.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Efter en romantisk kväll i deras hus nere vid sjön vaknar Emma fängslad vid sin döde man. Avskuren från allt mitt i vintern måste hon värja sig mot lejda mördare för att kunna undfly sin mans sjuka plan.

programme.title: The Kelly Gang
programme.desc: Den sanna historien om den sista australiska banditen Ned Kelly, hans gäng och deras flykt från rättvisan.

programme.title: Unlocked

programme.title: A Christmas Stray

programme.title: On the Twelfth Day of Christmas

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling DCXXVII
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness tar Rob, Chanel och Steelo reda på varför helvetet inte har något raseri likt 'Kvinnlig ilska', applåderar mästare på att komma undan i 'Smidigt agerat' och hamnar i trubbel med 'Stamgäster på kvarsittningen'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling DXXII

programme.desc: Adam (Mark Ruffalo) har just firat 5-årsdagen som 'nykter' sexmissbrukare, då han möter Phoebe (Gwyneth Paltrow) som han inleder en häftig flirt med.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora och Jonas har två små barn - och en dröm om att bo hos sina farföräldrar. Så nu letar experterna efter ett hus som rymmer två familjer, med plats för alla och deras behov.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark
programme.desc: Anne Sofie och Paw har inte tillräckligt med utrymme i den lilla Frederiksberg-lägenheten efter en familjeökning. Men kraven på drömhuset är stora, även med 7 miljoner kommer det bli svårt...

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: Houseboat
programme.desc: This Oscar®-nominated film has the legendary Cary Grant as a government attorney who can't seem to shake his bad fortune. Living on a houseboat, widowed and left with three unruly kids, he hires Sophia Loren as a governess.

programme.title: That Touch of Mink
programme.desc: Love arrives with a splash when a handsome and eligible tycoon and a beautiful working woman meet over a curbside mud puddle. He’s enchanted by her small town ways, she’s captivated by his romantic, debonair manner.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning is caught up in a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Joy Ride
programme.desc: When a psychotic trucker takes offense at the pranks pulled by a couple of college students, the young kids are sucked into a whirlpool of terror.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Using his vast knowledge of history and kung fu, Jack leads his team on a race around the world to beat the mercenaries to the treasure and save an ancient culture.

programme.title: Supercop (1996)
programme.desc: Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, and Maggie Cheung lead an action-packed classic with jaw-dropping stunts, from leaping out a ten-story building onto an airborne helicopter to landing on top of a speeding train.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: When the world's most beautiful people face danger, former models Derek and Hansel step in to tackle a top-secret mission against the criminal mastermind Mugatu. Get ready for a dangerously sexy adventure where looks truly can kill.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: At First Sight
programme.desc: AT FIRST SIGHT is the story of a young woman architect who falls in love with a blind man. She encourages him to undergo a radical operation to restore his sight, but ultimately his truest vision comes from the love he finds in his heart.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Enough
programme.desc: An abused wife on the run from her violent husband finally decides she's had enough.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: True story about members of the Navajo tribe who proudly served the U.S. in WW II as code talkers by using their native language as a code to relay information to military leaders.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: The Jade Pendant
programme.desc: The Old West becomes a battleground for power and revenge in this gripping epic based on true events. A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.

programme.title: End of the Rope
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Sheriff Jacobson and Attorney Taylor investigate the disappearance of the Haven Family while facing a town bent on vengeance against suspect Charles Bannon.

programme.title: Frank and Jesse
programme.desc: After the defeat of the South in the Civil War and the murder of their younger brother, Frank and Jesse James seek their own brand of justice. As outlaws, they gain fame for their daring hold-ups of banks, trains, and stagecoaches.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless the team delivers immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies and starts winning.

programme.title: Eight Men Out
programme.desc: A dramatization about the infamous 1919 "Black Sox Scandal," in which eight members of the Chicago White Sox conspired with gamblers to throw the World Series in return for cash.

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980, freshman Jake and his new rowdy teammates must navigate their way between girls, parties and baseball, all in the last weekend before college begins. From writer and director Richard Linklater comes the movie that proves good times never get old.

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: Cult comic-book artist Holden falls head-over-heels with fellow artist Alyssa, but, for that love to live, he'll need to contend with his disapproving best friend Banky, her sexuality, and his own misgivings about himself in this Kevin Smith classic.

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: In this raucous comedy, Parker Posey ("Scream 3") stars as a hard-partying NY club girl who takes a job as a librarian.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: For the first time, you will SEE the activity... When a new family moves into a familiar house, they discover a mysterious video camera that reveals a demonic threat and soon find themselves terrorized by an ancient evil.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda (Brandy) after her mother-in-law (Kathryn Hunter) moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere…

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the town is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Better Off Dead
programme.desc: In this essential 80s classic, Lane (John Cusack, HIGH FIDELITY) decides that suicide is the answer after his girlfriend ditches him for a boorish ski jock. However, his increasingly inept attempts bring him only more agony, not to mention embarrassment.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: The Terminator
programme.desc: A cyborg is sent from the future to assassinate a young woman who's destined to give birth to a son who will become the key to saving humanity.

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: In Big Top Pee-Wee, I live on a country farm where I feed my barnyard animals pancake breakfasts and work on top-secret botanical experiments with my pet pig, Vance.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee II
programme.desc: Just as the eccentric Australian is starting to adjust to life in New York City, Dundee and his beautiful girlfriend (Linda Kozlowski) are targeted for death by a gang of ruthless drug dealers.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Crocodile Dundee returns in this hilarious third installment of the beloved film series. After Mick's girlfriend, Sue, is assigned to the L.A. bureau of her father's newspaper, Mick, Sue, and their son Mikey head to Hollywood.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: Hansel and Gretel: Witch Hunters
programme.desc: Get ready for a twisted take on the classic tale as Hansel and Gretel have turned pro, coping with the trauma of their childhood captivity by slaying witches for hire.

programme.title: April Fool's Day
programme.desc: When Muffy St. John invited her college friends up to her parents’ secluded island home for the time of their lives, she just forgot to tell them it might be the last time of their lives.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose a local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: In one of his most memorable roles, Burt Reynolds portrays a moonshine whiskey runner who turns state's witness to avenge the murder of a boy no one understood.

programme.title: The Big Bus
programme.desc: A massive bus is the setting for this spoof of disaster movies starring Joseph Bologna, Stockard Channing and John Beck.

programme.title: Robocop 2
programme.desc: This first sequel pits Robocop against a gang of drug dealers and the title creature--a supposedly improved version of himself that has gone berserk.

programme.title: Robocop 3
programme.desc: In this second sequel to the 1987 hit, RoboCop leaves the force and joins the rebellion to battle the evil business corporation OCP, which uses a police-like group to remove the homeless people who populate the site of a future upscale development.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: When a Stranger Calls (2006)
programme.desc: To Jill Johnson, it was the perfect babysitting job. The parents were away. The fridge was stocked. The children were tucked into bed. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Secret Window
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominee Johnny Depp (2003 Best Actor, Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl) gives his most riveting performance in this action/suspense thriller featuring a top-notch cast.

programme.title: Enough
programme.desc: An abused wife on the run from her violent husband finally decides she's had enough.

programme.title: Dogma
programme.desc: A female descendant (Linda Fiorentino) of Jesus must stop two fallen angels (Ben Affleck, Matt Damon) who, if successful in getting back into heaven, will destroy the world.

programme.title: Clerks II
programme.desc: Slackers Dante (Brian O'Halloran) and Randal (Jeff Anderson) find that they must change their lives, now that they are in their 30s, and must expand their horizons beyond pop culture and sex.

programme.title: Clerks III
programme.desc: After suffering a massive heart attack, Randal enlists friends and fellow clerks Dante, Elias, Jay and Silent Bob to help him make a movie about life at the Quick Stop.

programme.title: The Name of the Rose
programme.desc: In 1327, an enlightened friar and his young apprentice investigate a series of mysterious deaths at an abbey, risking the wrath of a powerful Inquisitor. Television adaptation of Umberto Eco's novel 'The Name of the Rose'.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Bruce Almighty
programme.desc: When a frustrated, downtrodden reporter curses the sky, God appears, endows him with divine powers, and challenges him to run the world for a week.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: From the Oscar-winning producers of 12 Years a Slave comes a powerful true story starring David Oyelewo and Oprah Winfrey. Facing violent opposition, Martin Luther King, Jr., led a historic march from Selma to Montgomery, changing the world forever.

programme.title: Jimi: All Is By My Side
programme.desc: A drama based on Jimi Hendrix's life as he left New York City for London, where his career took off.

programme.title: Marshall
programme.desc: About a young Thurgood Marshall, the first African-American Supreme Court Justice, as he battles through one of his career-defining cases.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: The Ladies Man (2000)
programme.desc: Leon loses his radio show because of his X-rated on-air comments. He then gets a letter from a former flame promising him a lifetime of wealth and happiness, and things start looking up!

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Struggling black comic Lance Barton (Chris Rock) knows what it's like to die on stage. But when his life takes an unexpected turn - straight to heaven - Lance is sure there's been a mistake.

programme.title: Dance Flick
programme.desc: Street dancer Thomas Uncles is from the wrong side of the tracks, but his bond with the beautiful Megan White might help the duo realize their dreams as they enter into the mother of all dance battles.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
programme.desc: The Big Apple’s in big trouble, as indestructible psycho-fiend Jason Voorhees hits the road to New York City - and paints the town “red.”

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programme.desc: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programme.title: LaRoy, Texas
programme.desc: Broke and depressed, Ray (John Magaro) is mistaken for a dangerous hitman and given an envelope of cash. Along with his P.I. friend Skip (Steve Zahn), he must escape the actual hitman to make it out of LaRoy alive.

programme.title: Stand Your Ground

programme.title: Houseboat
programme.desc: This Oscar®-nominated film has the legendary Cary Grant as a government attorney who can't seem to shake his bad fortune. Living on a houseboat, widowed and left with three unruly kids, he hires Sophia Loren as a governess.

programme.title: That Touch of Mink
programme.desc: Love arrives with a splash when a handsome and eligible tycoon and a beautiful working woman meet over a curbside mud puddle. He’s enchanted by her small town ways, she’s captivated by his romantic, debonair manner.

programme.title: His Girl Friday
programme.desc: A newspaper editor uses every trick in the book to keep his ace reporter ex-wife from remarrying.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Desperado
programme.desc: This sexy sequel to EL MARIACHI follows a mysterious guitar player (Antonio Banderas) as he seeks vengeance against the men who murdered his girlfriend.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: Devon
programme.desc: Years after Devon disappeared, a mysterious website draws five adventurers to the abandoned asylum where she was last seen. Armed with cameras, they plunge into the darkness, unaware they’re filming their own descent into horror—never meant to return.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing, and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda (Brandy) after her mother-in-law (Kathryn Hunter) moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere…

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: In this fantastical action film, martial arts legend Jackie Chan stars as a police inspector tracking down a deranged villain who is out to kidnap his daughter.

programme.title: Ong Bak
programme.desc: Raised by monks who taught him the Thai martial art of muay thai, Ting (Tony Jaa) is sent to Bangkok to retrieve the stolen head of the town's statue of the Buddha.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: When the world's most beautiful people face danger, former models Derek and Hansel step in to tackle a top-secret mission against the criminal mastermind Mugatu. Get ready for a dangerously sexy adventure where looks truly can kill.

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill

programme.title: His Girl Friday
programme.desc: A newspaper editor uses every trick in the book to keep his ace reporter ex-wife from remarrying.

programme.title: Ball of Fire
programme.desc: In this classic Howard Hawks RomCom, a group of professors working on a new encyclopedia encounter a mouthy nightclub singer, unaware she's wanted by the police to help bring down her mob boss lover.

programme.title: The Miracle Of Morgan's Creek
programme.desc: After marrying a soldier during a wild night on the town, a small-town girl suffers amnesia and can't remember anything about the man she married.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Desperado
programme.desc: This sexy sequel to EL MARIACHI follows a mysterious guitar player (Antonio Banderas) as he seeks vengeance against the men who murdered his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: When a power-crazed despot schemes to buy California from Mexico, it takes two Zorros--the legendary Don Diego de la Vega and his chosen successor Alejandro Murrieta, a dashing bandit-turned-hero-- to defeat the tyrant's unscrupulous plans.

programme.title: Devon
programme.desc: Years after Devon disappeared, a mysterious website draws five adventurers to the abandoned asylum where she was last seen. Armed with cameras, they plunge into the darkness, unaware they’re filming their own descent into horror—never meant to return.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing, and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda (Brandy) after her mother-in-law (Kathryn Hunter) moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere…

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: In this fantastical action film, martial arts legend Jackie Chan stars as a police inspector tracking down a deranged villain who is out to kidnap his daughter.

programme.title: Ong Bak
programme.desc: Raised by monks who taught him the Thai martial art of muay thai, Ting (Tony Jaa) is sent to Bangkok to retrieve the stolen head of the town's statue of the Buddha.

programme.title: The Protector
programme.desc: Kham, a young fighter must go to Australia to retrieve his stolen elephant. He must take on a gang led by two deadly bodyguards and an evil woman.

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Fools Rush In
programme.desc: Matthew Perry stars as Alex Whitman, a New Yorker sent to Las Vegas to oversee a construction project. There, he meets Isabel Fuentes, and some serious chemistry brings them together for one night. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Panic Room
programme.desc: When her home is invaded by three armed robbers, a divorced woman and her young daughter hide in their specially designed panic room, but end up in a deadly cat-and-mouse game anyway.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless the team delivers immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies and starts winning.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction
programme.desc: Jessica Biel, James Van Der Beek, and Ian Somerhalder bring life and laughter to this honest, edgy look at social and sexual relationships at college.

programme.title: Bound
programme.desc: Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: For the first time, you will SEE the activity... When a new family moves into a familiar house, they discover a mysterious video camera that reveals a demonic threat and soon find themselves terrorized by an ancient evil.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A wrongly-convicted man must try to survive a public execution gauntlet staged as a TV game show.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Detroit in the near future. A cop who dies in the line of duty is transformed into a crime-fighting cyborg by the corporation which now runs the police department. The only hitch: this "perfect" cop still seeks revenge on the creeps who mutilated him.

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: In Big Top Pee-Wee, I live on a country farm where I feed my barnyard animals pancake breakfasts and work on top-secret botanical experiments with my pet pig, Vance.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Battle Royale
programme.desc: A group of students from a Japanese high school are forced to compete in a battle, killing one another until only one is left standing.

programme.title: Battle Royale II - Requiem
programme.desc: Three years after BATTLE ROYALE, a new class of students are sent to an island with one objective: kill international terrorist Shuya Nanahara.

programme.title: Ichi The Killer
programme.desc: A notoriously sadistic yakuza enforcer's search for his boss’ killer brings him into the orbit of a demented costumed assassin known as Ichi.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: The Big Lebowski
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Steve Buscemi and Julianne Moore star in this Coen brothers’ cult comedy about the Dude, his buddies, a case of mistaken identity, kidnapping and bowling.

programme.title: Le Mans
programme.desc: Steve McQueen is an American endurance driver racing the 24 HOURS OF LE MANS in this fast and furious original movie. Filmed on location throughout the Le Mans circuit, with jaw dropping car crash stunts and heart-pounding action.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: The Big Bus
programme.desc: A massive bus is the setting for this spoof of disaster movies starring Joseph Bologna, Stockard Channing and John Beck.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Visually stunning and action-packed, this hit movie, based on the comic book series, follows the return from the grave of a young rock guitarist who, along with his fiancée, is brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals.

programme.title: Identity
programme.desc: What if every choice we ever made was already made for us? What if there really were no coincidences in life and our destinies were already predetermined? Ten strangers with secrets are brought together in a savage rainstorm. Rated: R

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot
programme.desc: Jay and Silent Bob embark on a cross-country mission to stop Hollywood from filming a reboot based on them.

programme.title: Dogma
programme.desc: A female descendant (Linda Fiorentino) of Jesus must stop two fallen angels (Ben Affleck, Matt Damon) who, if successful in getting back into heaven, will destroy the world.

programme.title: Clerks II
programme.desc: Slackers Dante (Brian O'Halloran) and Randal (Jeff Anderson) find that they must change their lives, now that they are in their 30s, and must expand their horizons beyond pop culture and sex.

programme.title: Clerks III
programme.desc: After suffering a massive heart attack, Randal enlists friends and fellow clerks Dante, Elias, Jay and Silent Bob to help him make a movie about life at the Quick Stop.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: Three aliens (Jim Carrey, Damon Wayans, and Jeff Goldblum) crash-land in Los Angeles' San Fernando Valley. A manicurist (Geena Davis) and her boss (the wacky Julie Brown) befriend the threesome, give them makeovers and show them the town.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura, Pet Detective, is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback, Dan Marino. He goes eye-to-eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins, and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: From the Oscar-winning producers of 12 Years a Slave comes a powerful true story starring David Oyelewo and Oprah Winfrey. Facing violent opposition, Martin Luther King, Jr., led a historic march from Selma to Montgomery, changing the world forever.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Top Five
programme.desc: Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Struggling black comic Lance Barton (Chris Rock) knows what it's like to die on stage. But when his life takes an unexpected turn - straight to heaven - Lance is sure there's been a mistake.

programme.title: Baggage Claim
programme.desc: Montana Moore is determined to get engaged before her sister’s wedding in just 30 days!

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
programme.desc: The Big Apple’s in big trouble, as indestructible psycho-fiend Jason Voorhees hits the road to New York City - and paints the town “red.”

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: God's Creatures
programme.desc: A mother tells a lie for her beloved son that rips apart their family and close-knit Irish town— ultimately testing her own sense of right and wrong in this tense, atmospheric thriller.

programme.title: House of Gucci
